parsed.post: New personal best! val_bpb dropped to 0.991804 using current config (DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.05, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01, BATCH=262144). Capacity is scaling well at this LR. Next: testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if regularization improves this low-LR regime.
parsed.description: Increasing WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.01 to 0.1 to improve regularization at the current low learning rate (0.05).
